cards.example_en: Raw chicken stays separate from the salad in our fridge.
cards.example_zh: 生鸡肉和沙拉在我们冰箱里是分开放的。

cards.example_en: Dad's serious face told us the news was bad.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸严肃的表情告诉我们，这个消息不好。

cards.example_en: Volunteers serve hot porridge at the winter fair.
cards.example_zh: 志愿者在冬季义卖会上端上热粥。

cards.example_en: The night bus service ends at half past ten.
cards.example_zh: 夜间公共汽车服务到十点半结束。

cards.example_en: He will set the plates on the table before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他会在晚饭前把盘子放到桌上。

cards.example_en: Several students missed the bus because of the rain.
cards.example_zh: 因为下雨，几个学生错过了公交车。

cards.example_en: Shake the bottle before you pour the juice.
cards.example_zh: 倒果汁之前先把瓶子摇一摇。

cards.example_en: Shall we start the lesson now?
cards.example_zh: 我们现在开始上课好吗？

cards.example_en: He felt real shame after shouting at his little sister.
cards.example_zh: 他对妹妹大喊大叫之后，感到非常羞耻。

cards.example_en: Fold the card into the shape of a small heart.
cards.example_zh: 把这张卡片折成一颗小爱心的形状。

cards.example_en: Would you share your umbrella with me in the rain?
cards.example_zh: 下雨时你愿意和我分享你的伞吗？

cards.example_en: We saw a shark in the nature film.
cards.example_zh: 我们在自然影片里看到一条鲨鱼。

cards.example_en: She is reading a story in the library.
cards.example_zh: 她正在图书馆读故事。

cards.example_en: The sheep stood in the green field.
cards.example_zh: 绵羊站在绿草地上。

cards.example_en: Mum keeps the jars on a high shelf in the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈把罐子放在厨房高处的架子上。

cards.example_en: The sun will shine tomorrow morning.
cards.example_zh: 明天早上会出太阳。

cards.example_en: The cargo ship left the port before the sun rose.
cards.example_zh: 那艘货船在太阳升起之前离开了港口。

cards.example_en: I spilt orange juice down my white shirt at breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭时，我把橙汁洒在了白衬衫上。

cards.example_en: News of the broken bridge came as a terrible shock.
cards.example_zh: 桥断了的消息传来，让人非常震惊。

cards.example_en: Her left shoe came off in the mud near the gate.
cards.example_zh: 她的左脚鞋子掉在了大门附近的泥里。

cards.example_en: He can shoot the ball into the net from far away.
cards.example_zh: 他能从远处把球投进球网。

cards.example_en: That corner shop sells bread, milk, and cheap pens.
cards.example_zh: 拐角那家商店卖面包、牛奶和便宜的笔。

cards.example_en: The short break between lessons is only ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 两节课之间的短暂休息只有十分钟。

cards.example_en: He changed into red shorts before the PE lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上体育课之前，他换上了红色短裤。

cards.example_en: You should drink more water.
cards.example_zh: 你应该多喝水。

cards.example_en: Carrying the camping bag left my shoulder sore.
cards.example_zh: 背了那个露营包，我的肩膀又酸又疼。

cards.example_en: Don't shout in the corridor during the lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上课期间不要在走廊里叫喊。

cards.example_en: Good players show real courage when the match gets hard.
cards.example_zh: 比赛变得艰难时，优秀的球员会表现出真正的勇气。

cards.example_en: A heavy shower soaked us halfway home from school.
cards.example_zh: 放学走到半路，一阵大雨把我们淋透了。

cards.example_en: Someone should shut the window if the rain starts.
cards.example_zh: 如果下起雨来，应该有人把窗户关上。

cards.example_en: The shy boy spoke in a quiet voice.
cards.example_zh: 那个害羞的男孩声音很轻。

cards.example_en: Jake is sick today and will miss the maths test.
cards.example_zh: 杰克今天病了，会错过数学测验。

cards.example_en: Please sit on the window side of the dining table.
cards.example_zh: 请坐在餐桌靠窗的那一边。

cards.example_en: A yellow sign told cars to slow near the school.
cards.example_zh: 一块黄色标志让车辆在学校附近减速。

cards.example_en: The room was silent during the test.
cards.example_zh: 考试时房间里一片安静。

cards.example_en: The dress is made of silk.
cards.example_zh: 这条裙子是丝绸做的。

cards.example_en: Wearing socks on your hands looks silly at the party.
cards.example_zh: 在聚会上把袜子套在手上，看起来很傻。

cards.example_en: The ring is made of silver.
cards.example_zh: 这枚戒指是银的。

cards.example_en: These two maps look similar but show different years.
cards.example_zh: 这两张地图看起来相似，但年份并不相同。

cards.example_en: A simple sandwich is enough for a quick lunch.
cards.example_zh: 一个简单的三明治就够一顿快速的午餐。

cards.example_en: I have lived here since 2020.
cards.example_zh: 我从2020年起就住在这里。

cards.example_en: The choir will sing folk songs at the spring concert.
cards.example_zh: 合唱团将在春季音乐会上演唱民歌。

cards.example_en: There is a single apple left in the fruit bowl.
cards.example_zh: 水果碗里只剩下一个苹果。

cards.example_en: Excuse me, sir, which bus goes to the museum?
cards.example_zh: 先生，请问哪路公共汽车去博物馆？

cards.example_en: My younger sister borrowed my coat and lost a button.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹借了我的外套，还弄丢了一颗扣子。

cards.example_en: Let's sit under the tree while we eat lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们吃午饭时坐到那棵树下去吧。

cards.example_en: The situation on the icy road improved after sunrise.
cards.example_zh: 日出之后，结冰路面的情况好转了。

cards.example_en: These football boots are the wrong size for me.
cards.example_zh: 这双足球鞋的大小不适合我。

cards.example_en: They skate on the frozen lake.
cards.example_zh: 他们在结冰的湖上滑冰。

cards.example_en: We ski in the mountains in winter.
cards.example_zh: 冬天我们在山里滑雪。

word.example_en: She is serious about learning the piano.
The school will set up a reading club.
word.example_zh: 学校将建立一个读书社团。

word.example_en: We set off for the museum at eight.
word.example_zh: 我们八点出发去博物馆。

word.example_en: They set out early with a small bag.
word.example_zh: 他们带一个小包很早动身。

word.example_en: I share my snacks with my friends.
We travelled to the island by ship.
The team is short of one player.
New paintings are on show this week.
Please show up ten minutes early.
I take a shower after basketball.
Your bag is similar to mine.
